# Claude Code Remote Control for macOS (claude-code-remote-control-launchd)

> A macOS launchd LaunchAgent that keeps Claude Code Remote Control (`claude remote-control`) running in the background, so your Mac stays available as a device card in the Claude app (Code tab) and on claude.ai/code. One-command install and uninstall. MIT licensed. Unofficial community project, not affiliated with Anthropic.

Install: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sicaboy/claude-code-remote-control-launchd/main/install.sh | bash -s -- --workdir ~/projects --name "My Mac"`
Uninstall: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sicaboy/claude-code-remote-control-launchd/main/install.sh | bash -s -- uninstall`
Requirements: macOS, Claude Code signed in with a claude.ai account (`claude auth login`), a work directory trusted by Claude Code.
